Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Cytologic or histologic proof of adenocarcinoma of the pancreatic head or uncinate process is required prior to treatment. Islet cell tumors are not eligible.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's description does not mention any diagnosis of pancreatic adenocarcinoma or islet cell tumors.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients must be staged with a physical exam, CXR, and contrast-enhanced CT. Only potentially resectable patients are eligible. Potentially resectable defined as: a) no extra pancreatic disease, b) no evidence (on CT) of tumor extension to the celiac axis or SMA, and c) no evidence (CT or angiogram) of occlusion of the SMV or SMPV confluence. Visceral angiography is optional. Laparoscopic staging is not part of the pretreatment evaluation for this study. Laparoscopy may be performed prior to planned laparotomy at surgeon's discretion. Staging needs to be done within 28 days of enrollment.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information provided about the patient's staging or the results of any imaging studies related to pancreatic cancer.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients cannot have known hepatic or peritoneal metastases detected by ultrasound (US), CT scan, or laparotomy prior to chemoradiation.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's description does not mention any findings of hepatic or peritoneal metastases.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: There will be no upper age restriction; patients with Karnofsky performance status greater than 70 are eligible.
